scientific_integrity: An analytical all-size proof; finite exact-rational graph enumeration is corroboration, not a proof of the infinite case. Originality comparison is best-effort rather than exhaustive; independent scientific audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Uniform fixed-cardinality edge failures on a simple cycle; uniform source; deterministic propagation along surviving edges; perfect preplaced sentinels; no time metric or dynamical epidemic model.
title: Optimal epidemic sentinels on a cycle with a fixed number of failed contacts
